mapper.select: SELECT SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_CTGRY_LVL , SRVC_CTGRY_ORD , USE_YN , SRVC_CTGRY_NM , SRVC_CTGRY_TREE_NM , SRVC_CTGRY_DESC , PRNT_SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_CTGRY_SORT_PATH FROM SVC_SRVC_CTGRY_TREE_VIEW ORDER BY SRVC_CTGRY_SORT_PATH;

SELECT SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_LVL , SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_ORD , SRVC_CTGRY.USE_YN , SRVC_CTGRY.PRNT_SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_NM , SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_DESC , TO_CHAR(SRVC_CTGRY.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SRVC_CTGRY.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_CTGRY.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SRVC_CTGRY.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SRVC_CTGRY.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_CTGRY.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM SVC_SRVC_CTGRY_INFO_TBL SRVC_CTGRY WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_CTGRY.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_CTGRY.SRVC_CTGRY_CD = #{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prntSrvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prntSrvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_CTGRY.PRNT_SRVC_CTGRY_CD = #{prntSrvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
